name: Tsagantegia
sum: Tsagantegia is an ankylosaurid from the Bayan Shireh Formation of Mongolia, known only from a skull with an elongated snout.
holotype: MPC 700/17, a skull without postcranial remains found in 1983 by the Joint Soviet-Mongolian expedition — Bayan Shireh Formation, Tsagan Teg, Mongolia.
biology: Characterised by an elongated snout and flattened facial osteoderms.
author: Tumanova 1993
